$extensions.aesthetic: cinematic chiaroscuro — deep black surfaces, surgical Rosso Corsa accents, Italian luxury restraint

surface.$description: Nero Profondo — primary background, cinematic depth, not pure black to allow layering

surface-elevated.$description: Carbon Fiber — card surfaces, elevated panels, vehicle spec containers

surface-subtle.$description: Grigio Scuro — secondary surfaces, footer, navigation dropdowns

surface-overlay.$description: Overlay — modal backdrops, image overlays for text legibility

accent.$description: Rosso Corsa — THE Ferrari red, used with extreme restraint: CTAs, active states, brand moments only

accent-hover.$description: Rosso Vivace — brighter red for hover/focus, never at rest

accent-muted.$description: Rosso Scuro — darkened red for pressed states, subtle red accents on dark surfaces

accent-secondary.$description: Oro Ferrari — gold accent for Scuderia badges, premium tier indicators, heritage elements

text-primary.$description: Bianco Puro — headlines, vehicle names, primary content on dark surfaces

text-secondary.$description: Argento — body copy, descriptions, secondary information

text-tertiary.$description: Grigio Medio — metadata, timestamps, technical specs labels

text-on-accent.$description: White on Rosso Corsa — CTA text, badges on red

text-on-gold.$description: Near-black on gold — premium tier badges

error.$description: Error Red — distinct from Rosso Corsa, lighter and more orange to differentiate from brand red

success.$description: Verde Semaforo — green light, racing start signal, positive status

warning.$description: Giallo Modena — amber warning, Ferrari's secondary heritage color (the Prancing Horse background)

info.$description: Info Blue — informational callouts, neutral against the red palette

border-default.$description: Whisper border — barely visible containment on dark surfaces

border-hover.$description: Hover border — slightly more visible on interaction

border-accent.$description: Red glow border — active/selected state with Rosso Corsa tint

font-display.$description: Display/headline font — Ferrari Sans is proprietary, fallbacks chosen for similar geometric precision

font-body.$description: Body/UI font — same family, different weights create hierarchy

font-mono.$description: Monospace — vehicle specs, lap times, performance data

scale-hero.$description: Hero — vehicle name reveals, cinematic headlines, one per page maximum

scale-display.$description: Display — section anchors, model family names

scale-subheading.$description: Subheading — card titles, spec category headers

scale-body-large.$description: Body Large — lead paragraphs, vehicle descriptions

scale-overline.$description: Overline — category labels, all-caps tags above headlines

line-height-tight.$description: Tight — hero headlines, vehicle names, maximum drama

letter-spacing-tight.$description: Tight tracking — hero and display headlines

letter-spacing-wide.$description: Wide tracking — overlines, uppercase labels, navigation

weight-light.$description: Light — large display text for elegance

weight-bold.$description: Bold — section headings, vehicle names, primary emphasis

unit.$description: Base grid unit — all spacing derives from this

xs.$description: Extra small — icon-to-label gaps, tight badge padding

2xl.$description: Double extra large — major content blocks

3xl.$description: Triple extra large — section top/bottom padding

section-gap.$description: Section spacing — cinematic breathing room between content blocks

container-max.$description: Max container width — wider than typical for edge-to-edge photography

content-max.$description: Max content width — text and card grids

radius-none.$description: Sharp — buttons, precision edges, engineering feel

level-1.$description: Subtle lift — cards on dark surfaces need heavier shadows to register

red-glow.$description: Red glow — hover state on Rosso Corsa CTAs, active navigation

duration-fast.$description: Fast — button state changes, tooltip reveals

duration-slow.$description: Slow — page section reveals, hero image transitions

duration-cinematic.$description: Cinematic — vehicle reveal animations, full-screen transitions

easing-dramatic.$description: Dramatic ease-out — vehicle reveals, hero transitions, cinematic entrances

easing-precision.$description: Precision — spec counter animations, data reveals

reduced-duration.$description: Near-zero duration for prefers-reduced-motion. Applied via media query.

reduced-easing.$description: Linear easing for reduced motion -- no spring/bounce.
